description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer class (VersionCodec) for the Version type, along with its surrogate struct. It facilitates serialization and deserialization of Version objects within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: VersionCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the System.Version type, converting between Version and its surrogate for serialization.

classes.name: VersionSurrogate
classes.description: A surrogate struct used for serializing the Version object, containing major, minor, build, and revision components.

methods.name: VersionCodec
methods.description: Constructor initializing the codec with a surrogate serializer.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a VersionSurrogate instance back to a Version object.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a Version object into its surrogate form for serialization.
